label: Optimizing-giving laws and a tied-optimum model on the root's giving
paraphrase: Premise-free laws and two finite models (structural surrogates, not metaphysical possibility). Laws: (1) under the giving-output adapter, cross-world stable output is exactly being fixed (NECESSITATE_5) toward every being given at w; (2) a root that gives by total optimal output with a unique optimum is fixed toward every being it gives at w and two-way toward none, so it cannot be a mixed-mode root; (3) with SS, such a root giving some other being at w by exercising a rational power makes WN fail; (4) such a root gives being to at most one being at w; (5) with (b1) and the common root's reach, it leaves at most one actual concretum at w besides itself. Tied model: on a frame where the GOD_4 root with intellect exists at both worlds and gives a different contingent at each, the premises of the refutation other than uniqueness hold, the root gives by total optimal output over two tied candidates, both are optimal, here the tied root is two-way toward the first, and the unique-optimum rival fails. Mediated model: on #1947's chain frame the unique-optimum rival holds with the necessary intermediary as sole candidate, the common root's direct reach fails, and some concrete being is contingent, so without direct reach a unique-optimum root can be a mediated creator. Encoding disclosures: quality is constant; G and existence are fixed by construction; the Ontic causal field and other relations are empty; in the tied model the second contingent exists only at the second world.
